full_query: So what does the non reactive mean for the hep a igm

shared_context.topic: non-reactive result for the Hepatitis A IgM antibody test

sentences: A non-reactive result for the Hepatitis A IgM antibody test indicates that there is no detectable level of IgM antibodies against the Hepatitis A virus in the blood sample
This typically means that the individual has not been recently infected with the Hepatitis A virus, as IgM antibodies are usually present during an acute or recent infection
